Consider the square region $Δ$ in the $uv$-plane, given by

$$
Δ={(u,v)\,:\,0\le u\le \sqrt{5},\,\,0\le v\le \frac{3\pi }{4}},
$$

and the transformation $T,$ given by

$$
T:(u,v)\to (u\operatorname{cos}⁡v,\,u\operatorname{sin}⁡v).
$$

The image of the top side of $Δ$ under the action of $T$ is a line segment. Which of the following statements are true regarding the image?

- The image makes the angle of $0$ with the positive $x$-axis.
- The image makes the angle of $\frac{3\pi }{4}$ with the positive $x$-axis.
- One endpoint of the image is the origin $O$ of the $xy$-plane, and the other endpoint lies on the circle of radius $5$ centered at $O.$

choices.value: None of the statements are true

Consider the square region $Δ$ in the $uv$-plane, given by

$$
Δ={(u,v)\,:\,0\le u\le 4,\,\,\frac{3\pi }{4}\le v\le \frac{7\pi }{6}},
$$

and the transformation $T,$ given by

$$
T:(u,v)\to (u\operatorname{cos}⁡v,\,u\operatorname{sin}⁡v).
$$

Which of the following could be the image of the bottom side of $Δ$ under the action of $T?$
feedback.worked_solution:
To map the entire region $Δ$ onto the $xy$-plane, we consider the transformation of each side. However, in this case, we consider only the bottom side.

For the bottom side, we have $v=\frac{3\pi }{4}$ and $0\le u\le 4.$ 

Substituting $v=\frac{3\pi }{4}$ into our transformation equations, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}(x,y) & =T(u,v) \\  & =(u\operatorname{cos}⁡v,\,u\operatorname{sin}⁡v) \\  & =(u\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{4}),\,u\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{4})),\,0\le u\le 4.\end{aligned}
$$

This is a parametric equation of the line segment that makes an angle of $\frac{3\pi }{4}$ with the positive $x$-axis, where one endpoint is the point $O,$ while the other endpoint lies on the circle of radius $4$ centered at $O,$ as shown below.
